chapters.title: In Search of Lost Time
chapters.goal: Turn back time at the Tower of Lost Time, beat [[Jasper]] and [[Mordegon]] in the new timeline, and reach Havens Above to unlock the open-ended post-game.

steps.t: Try to leave Arboria after the party scene.
Zoom to the Dundrasil camp when you are ready to push the story on.
Go through the northern pass toward Octagonia.
Go south to the Mysterious Ruins.
Take the [[Wheel of Time]] on their west side.
Fly [[Cetacea]] to the tower north of Yggdrasil.
Open the chest behind the tower to the northwest for [[Good Godly Gear]].
Open the tower door with the [[Wheel of Time]].
Collect [[A Hero's Book of Basic Weapons]] on the northern cog route to evolve your [[Poker]], [[Stardust Sword]] or [[Bad axe]].
Talk to every companion at the Altar of Ages.
Agree through [[Erik]].
Shatter the Time Sphere.
Re-equip the party with the gear they wore at the end of Act II; their levels come back later in the story.
Walk straight through the First Forest to Yggdrasil without grinding, using the Orbs at the altar.
Against [[Jasper]], spam [[Sword Dance]] with the [[Luminary]] (550+ per use against roughly 2055 HP) while [[Sylvando]] heals.
If [[Jasper]] cloaks himself with the Orb, hit him with the [[Luminary]] first to break it before the others attack.
In Heliodor Castle, grab the [[Seed of Defence]] from the kitchen side room.
Grab the [[Mighty armlet]] from Hendrik's quarters.
Save with the Priest.
Against [[Mordegon]] (2500 HP), ignore the staves unless you are using group attacks.
Use [[Boom]] with [[Veronica]] when the staves are out.
Have [[Sylvando]] or [[Veronica]] cast [[Oomph]] on the [[Luminary]].
Attack with [[Sword Dance]] or [[Unbridled Blade]].
If Purple Mist is active, stop all healing spells until it fades, because it turns healing and buffs against you.
Travel to the Emerald Coast.
Take the [[Calamus Flute]].
Fly to the floating island in the northeast.
Speak to the Elder at the Place of Legends in Havens Above.
Open the nearby chest for the [[Ultimate key]].
Take the Guiding Light at the Temple of Dawn to restore levels and Zoom points.
Plan skills toward [[Gigagash]], [[Kaboomle]], [[Grace of the Goddess]] and [[Clear Your Mind]].
Accept Quest 48 [[Wisdom of the Warrior King]] on the southwest island and Quest 49 from the Watcher by the northeast Item shop.

get: [[Good Godly Gear]] - Lost Land, chest behind the Tower of Lost Time
[[A Hero's Book of Basic Weapons]] - Tower of Lost Time, before the last cog
[[Calamus Flute]] - from Veronica on the Emerald Coast
[[Ultimate key]] - Havens Above, Place of Legends chest

chapters.title: A Tour of Erdrea
chapters.goal: Clear the Ultimate Key doors, rebuild Cobblestone through the Malicious boss events, and restore Cetacea's power so the Drustan Trials open.

level.t: Start this stage at level 57 or higher, and be around level 60-64 before the Heliodor quests and Bathysfear; levelling to 99 now trivializes the post-game.

steps.t: Speak to Gemma at your home in Cobblestone to begin the rebuilding quest that runs through all of Act III.
Fight the Malicious [[Hades condor]] in Cobblestone Tor (about 4500 HP).
Have [[Hendrik]] cast [[Magic Barrier]] against its 200+ HP [[Kasizzle]].
Heal with [[Sage's stone]].
Attack the condor with [[Sword Dance]] and a [[Re-Vamp]]ed [[Jade]] using [[Multifeet]].
Climb the Tor summit to accept Quest 50 [[Mister Vista]].
Talk to the King of Heliodor for the [[Golden tiara]].
Take Tome 1 of Quest 48 from Jasper's room.
Open the dungeon cells for [[King of the Swindlers]].
Liberate Gondolia.
Open its Ultimate Key door for 50000G.
Haggle the merchant brothers down to 20000G for Jade's [[Divine bustier]].
Ride a Malicious [[Dragooner]] around Insula Centralis for [[Orichalcum]] and three [[Agate of Evolution]].
Finish [[Mister Vista]] in Cobblestone Tor for a [[Fantastick]].
At the First Forest Whale Way Station, take [[Upper-Class Accessories]] and the [[Pepper tree branch]].
Hand the branch to Faris to finish [[Perfectly Pepped Paladins]] for four [[Pep pip]]s.
Trade Mini Medals at L'Academie for the [[Circle of serendipity]].
Forge the [[Straight poker]] at a camp.
Rework the [[Metal king armour]] and [[Fantastick]] at a camp.
In the Kingsbarrow, Pep Up [[Sylvando]] and [[Hendrik]] on the way down.
Bench them.
Wear [[Tweedledoom]] (3000 HP, Seismic Shock) to orange HP first.
Swap [[Sylvando]] and [[Hendrik]] in to finish each Tweedle with Executioner; if [[Hendrik]] is no longer Pepped for the second one, throw him a [[Pep pip]].
From here on, open every big fight with [[Hendrik]] casting [[Immense Defence]].
Have [[Hendrik]] follow with [[Forbearance]].
Let [[Sylvando]] hand turns to [[Jade]] with [[Ladies First]].
Fight the Malicious [[Gloomnivore]] under Dundrasil (about 5200 HP).
Land [[Sap]] and Blunt on him.
Attack with [[Sword Dance]] and [[Multifeet]].
Against the Malicious [[Merking]] at The Strand, focus the Merking.
Hit the [[Mermaniac]]s only with group attacks like [[Kaboomle]], [[Gold Rush]] and [[Pink Tornado]].
Bring [[Serena]] and [[Sylvando]] to the [[Merking]] fight.
Hunt a [[Harmachis]] at the Southern Hotto Steppe station with the [[Circle of serendipity]] to finish [[Might Is Right!]] for the [[Apollo's axe]].
Fight [[Bathysfear]] (about 5600 HP).
Keep HP above 300.
Tank Ready Blade with [[Forbearance]].
Land [[Sap]] before the [[Luminary]] starts attacking.
In the Caverns Under Octagonia, beat the MMA fighters with [[Kaboomle]] fed by [[Sylvando]].
Face the Malicious [[Arachtagon]] (about 5600 HP) with a twice [[Re-Vamp]]ed [[Jade]] and [[Snap, Crackle, Poof]].
Against the Malicious [[Grey gordon]] (about 5400 HP), kill Gordon first.
Clear Gordon's summons with [[Pink Tornado]], [[Kaboomle]] and [[Gigagash]] or [[Quadraslash]].
Against the Malicious [[Jörmun]] (about 2800 HP), land the killing blow with a [[Zap]]-family spell from the [[Luminary]].
Bring [[Erik]] to the [[Jörmun]] fight for [[Cock-a-doodle-doo]] against [[Kasnooze]].
Against the Malicious Arboreal Serpent (about 7600 HP), equip Paralysis protection.
Bring [[Sylvando]] to the Arboreal Serpent fight for [[Tingle]], [[Oomphle]] and [[Ladies First]].
Touch the last Seedlings at the Laguna di Gondolia and Zwaardsrust stations.
Take the [[Wheel of Time]] from the Elder.
Climb the Tower of Lost Time again.

get: [[Divine bustier]] - Gondolia merchant brothers, haggle to 20000G
[[Pirate king's coat]] - rebuilt Cobblestone shop, completes Erik's set
[[Glammer Gear for Goer-Getterers]] - L'Academie Mini Medal reward
[[The Way of the War Goddess]] - Battleground B9, after the [[Crystalotl]]
[[Harmonicrystal]] - from the [[Crystalotl]], completes Quest 49
[[Gemma's eternal charm]] - Gemma, once Cobblestone is rebuilt

chapters.title: An Old Friend
chapters.goal: Follow the shadow through Heliodor Castle and win Hendrik's solo duel with [[Shadow Jasper]] for the [[Twin eagle armour]] costume.

steps.t: Stack dark resistance on [[Hendrik]] before starting, for example the [[Field marshal's finery]] (40% at +3) and the [[Ruinous shield]] (50% at +3).
Talk to the guard with the pink speech bubble in the main hall of Heliodor Castle.
Touch the Yggdrasil root in the courtyard.
Follow the shadow to the dining hall's side room.
Interact at the shelf.
Go to Jasper's old room.
Interact with the shadow.
Read the journal on the table.
Follow the shadow from the main hall past the throne room and upstairs to the balcony to trigger the duel.
Attack with your strongest single-target skill: [[Parallax]] with an axe, [[Unbridled Blade]] with a greatsword, or [[Gyrfalcon Slash]] with a sword.
Heal with [[Moreheal]] only when needed.
Against [[Jasper Unbound]], skip buffs unless you need them, since his disruptive wave strips them.
Keep attacking in the third phase, when the darkness damages Jasper on its own and most of his attacks miss.

get: [[Twin eagle armour]] - reward for the duel, needed for the costume trophy

chapters.title: The Drustan Trials
chapters.goal: Clear Drustan's three trial dungeons and four of the five turn-limited trial bosses, forging the [[Supreme Sword of Light]] and the Drustan, Erdwin and Serenica sets along the way.

level.t: Be level 65 or higher for [[Blind hatred]] and at least level 70 for the Citadel of Spite, where the monsters give a lot of experience.

steps.t: Go through the glyph door in the ruins west of the Warrior's Rest Inn.
Take the portal into the Realm Between Worlds.
In Drustan's Labyrinth, loot the [[Sacred armour]] behind the cabin and the [[Serpent's soul]], using a [[Visor kaiser]] mount to break the ice.
At Trial Isle, forge new gear.
Zoom to Havens Above.
Accept Quest 60 [[Lost Lovers]] from the Watcher.
In the Cruel Crypt, drop through the southeast hole for [[Kings of the Rings]].
Take [[Erdwin's bracelet]] from the slot machine room.
In the Eerie Valley, collect the [[Lumen essence]], [[A Hero's Book of Better Weapons]] and [[Drustan's helm]].
Put the helm on [[Hendrik]].
Fight [[Blind hatred]] (4200 HP, 25 turns).
Tank with [[Hendrik]]'s [[Immense Defence]] and [[Forbearance]].
Kill each 900 HP Shadow fast.
Deal damage with [[Re-Vamp]]ed [[Multifeet]] boosted by [[Sylvando]]'s [[Ladies First]], or [[Erik]]'s poison-boosted [[Divide]] attacks under [[Oomphle]].
Pick the Super Powerful Weapon wish first to get [[Supreme Secrets of the Sword of Light]].
Turn in [[Lost Lovers]].
In Hotto, accept [[The Legendary Treasure of Legend]] at the Inn.
Sell [[Orichalcum]] to the man outside the western Item shop.
Collect the [[Hotto stuff]] past Mount Huji's Secret Entrance.
Give Miko the [[Lumen essence]].
Buy the [[Sword of Kings]].
Get the [[Crucible key]].
Win the Easy Gold Cup at the Gallopolis Racetrack for the [[Forging hammer]], aiming for a lap time of 22-23 seconds.
Trade two [[Serpent's soul]]s to Krystalinda for [[Crimsonite]]s.
Forge a [[Sword of Light]] at the Crucible.
Forge the [[Supreme Sword of Light]] on Trial Isle.
Dual-wield the [[Super Sword of Light]] and [[Supreme Sword of Light]] +3 on the [[Luminary]] if he knows [[Gigagash]] and [[Sword Dance]].
Loot [[Serenica's circlet]] in the Fierce Forest.
Loot [[Drustan's shield]] and [[Eternal Elegance]] in Hoarder's Keep, using [[Peep]] to spot the Token Takers.
Fight [[Unfathomable anger]] (7500 HP, 30 turns).
Land [[Sap]].
Tank with [[Hendrik]].
Have a double [[Re-Vamp]]ed [[Jade]] use [[Multifeet]] for 1000+ damage.
Pick the wedding wish.
Rework [[Drustan's shield]] to +3.
Finish the L'Academie album for [[Erdwin's shield]] and [[Making Things with Metal Kings]].
In the Citadel of Spite, take [[Drustan's Sword]].
Switch [[Hendrik]] to sword and shield.
Open the red door for [[Drustan's armour]], [[Erdwin's tunic]] and [[Serenica's surplice]].
Fight [[Sheer Decadence]] (4800 HP) and [[All-consuming greed]] (about 2600 HP, 40 turns).
Open with [[Veronica]]'s [[Magic Burst]] for 1500+.
Bench [[Veronica]].
Keep [[Hendrik]] tanking and [[Serena]] on [[Omniheal]].
Use [[Gigagash]] while both live.
Take the [[Ogler's digest]] wish.
Against [[Abject terror]] (7800 HP) and [[Darkest despair]] (4200 HP, 50 turns), drop both low before killing either so neither gets revived with [[Kazing]].
Hit [[Abject terror]] with magic and [[Darkest despair]] with physical attacks.

get: [[Kings of the Rings]] - Cruel Crypt, lower level southeast
[[Supreme Secrets of the Sword of Light]] - first wish from Drustan
[[Eternal Elegance]] - Hoarder's Keep, Level 1 south
[[Drustan's Sword]] - Citadel of Spite, Level 3 exterior
[[Erdwin's Coronet]] - Citadel of Spite, Level 3 northwest
[[Ye Manifold Methods of Mighty Drustan]] - Citadel of Spite, under the Level 1 stairs

chapters.title: Echoes of an Elusive Age
chapters.goal: Level the party to 99, clear the Wheel of Harma, beat [[Overweening pride]] for the last wish, and defeat [[Calasmos]].

level.t: Get every character to level 99 before the Wheel of Harma, [[Overweening pride]] and [[Calasmos]].

steps.t: Learn [[Pep Up]] on the [[Luminary]], [[Lightning Thrust]] on [[Jade]] and [[Critical Claim]] on [[Erik]] before you start levelling.
Near a camp, defend in a battle until [[Erik]], [[Jade]], [[Sylvando]] and [[Rab]] are Pepped.
End the battle with the [[Luminary]] using [[Pep Up]].
Save.
Give [[Sylvando]] a [[Pep pip]].
Start a battle with the [[Luminary]], [[Erik]], [[Jade]] and [[Sylvando]].
Cast Haulellujah.
Swap [[Erik]] for [[Rab]].
Re-Pep the [[Luminary]].
Have [[Sylvando]] use a [[Pep pip]] on [[Jade]].
Let the enemies act.
Cast [[Electro Light]].
If no metal slimes appear, reload.
If metal slimes appear, sleep them with [[Dirge of Dundrasil]].
Kill the sleeping metal slimes with [[Critical Claim]] and [[Lightning Thrust]] for 4-6 levels per run.
In Harma trials one to three, open with [[Sword Dance]], [[Gigagash]] or [[Pink Tornado]].
Finish groups with [[Kathwack]], [[Pearly Gates]] or [[Magic Burst]].
In the Fourth Trial, use [[Critical Claim]] on each [[Hardy hand]] and [[Gyrfalcon Slash]] on the [[Clangoustine]].
Use [[Sword Dance]] on the [[Red giant]] solo.
In the Final Trial, kill every enemy in the same round to stop reinforcements.
Open with [[Hendrik]]'s [[Gyrfalcon Slash]] on the [[Shadeshifter]] and [[Rab]]'s [[Pearly Gates]].
In the Final Trial's second battle, open with [[Channel Anger]] and [[Kaswooshle]].
End the battle with [[Veronica]]'s [[Magic Burst]].
In the third battle, have [[Erik]] use [[Divide]] and [[Sylvando]] use [[That's Amore]].
Use [[Critical Claim]] on the [[Pandora's big bad box]] while [[Sylvando]] uses [[Gold Rush]].
Stay within 14 actions.
In the last battle, wear down the [[Infernal serpent]] (4000 HP) and [[Manticore]] (3600 HP).
Use [[Gigagash]] and [[Pink Tornado]] so all fall together.
Forge the [[Legate's blade]] +3.
Give the [[Legate's blade]] to the High Hall monk to finish [[Pointless Pride]] for Seeds of Skill.
Equip [[Hendrik]] with two [[Skull ring]] +3 for full dark immunity.
Forge gear to +3.
Give [[Elfin elixir]]s to [[Veronica]] and [[Serena]].
Against [[Overweening pride]] (12000 HP, 50 turns), keep [[Hendrik]] on [[Immense Defence]] and [[Forbearance]].
Have [[Serena]] use [[Omniheal]] and [[Divine Intervention]] on [[Hendrik]].
Bring [[Erik]] with dual swords for [[Divide]] plus [[Fatal Flash]].
Use the [[Luminary]]'s [[Gigagash]] once reinforcements arrive.
Spend Pep Powers before Disruptive Wave removes them: [[Mighty Magic Burst]] for 4000+, or [[Yggdragon's Blessing]].
Use [[Kerplunk]] if most of the party is down.
Keep the [[Super Sword of Light]] on the [[Luminary]].
Stock MP items and [[Yggdrasil leaf]]s.
Fly [[Cetacea]] toward the dark star.
On the [[Luminary]]'s first turn against [[Calasmos]], use the [[Super Sword of Light]] from the inventory to strip the dark aura.
Fight [[Calasmos]] with [[Hendrik]] tanking, [[Serena]] on [[Omniheal]], and the [[Luminary]] and [[Veronica]] using [[Gigagash]] and [[Kaboomle]] on the [[Darkling]]s.
Cast [[Magic Barrier]] against Projectile of Darkness (250+ to the party).
Spend your saved [[Pep pop]]s and [[Elfin elixir]]s here.

get: [[Shine On, Xenlon]] - Wheel of Harma, Fourth Trial reward
[[A Hero's Book of Brilliant Weapons]] - for taking all five of Drustan's wishes
[[Skull ring]] - forge, or rare steal from [[Infanticore]]s in Dundrasil

chapters.title: Wheel of Harma's Secret Trial
chapters.goal: Clear the four-round Secret Trial at the Wheel of Harma for Super Seeds of Defence without any seed farming.

level.t: Have every character at level 99 in their strongest gear before attempting it.

steps.t: Unlock the Secret Trial by finishing all of Drustan's Trials and every other Wheel of Harma trial within its turn limit.
Equip two [[Catholicon ring]]s each on the [[Luminary]] and [[Jade]], and two [[Venus' tear]]s each on [[Erik]] and [[Sylvando]].
Give [[Erik]] two [[Hunter's moon]]s.
Put [[Meteorite bracer]]s on [[Serena]] and [[Hendrik]] so they act before [[Veronica]].
Pep Up [[Veronica]] and [[Serena]] before entering the trial.
In round 1, have [[Serena]] start [[Mighty Magic Burst]].
Have [[Hendrik]] throw an [[Elfin elixir]] to [[Veronica]].
Have [[Veronica]] finish with [[Magic Burst]].
If the turn order goes wrong or the [[Archbashop]] casts [[Bounce]], flee or reload.
Retry round 1.
In round 2, cast [[Infinite Wisdom]] on [[Rab]] first.
Use [[Kacrackle]] every turn against [[Boodica]] without recasting the buff.
If [[Rab]] gets low, especially once the doppelganger appears, heal him with [[Fullheal]] or a [[Yggdrasil dew]].
In round 3, have [[Erik]] use [[Divide]] while [[Sylvando]] casts [[Oomphle]] on him.
Use [[Double Down]] aimed at the [[Coralossus]].
If the [[Coralossus]] uses [[Forbearance]], have [[Sylvando]] use [[Gold Rush]] (about 300 each) while [[Erik]] keeps using [[Double Down]].
In round 4, attack [[Grand Master Pang]] nonstop, healing only with the [[Luminary]]'s [[Omniheal]].
Use [[Re-Vamp]] once with [[Jade]] in her spellcasting stance.
Keep [[Multifeet]] and [[Sword Dance]] on Pang when she summons an [[Equinox]] and a [[Godsteed]].
Brace on the turn after her second power-up.
Once Pang falls, clear the horses with [[Pink Tornado]] and [[Gigagash]] or [[Quadraslash]].
Finish in under 50 moves for extra Super Seeds of Defence, since the reward cannot be earned again.

chapters.title: Timewyrm
chapters.goal: Beat the [[Timewyrm]] superboss through the rift above the Tower of Lost Time, most reliably by looping [[Yggdragon's Blessing]] with [[Pep pop]]s and [[Magic Burst]].

steps.t: Unlock the fight by defeating the [[End of Time]] in the Deepest Recesses of the Past.
If fighting without the Pep Power trick, farm only [[Seed of defence]], [[Seed of life]] and [[Seed of strength]], aiming for 999 HP, 999 Attack and about 500 defence.
Buy a stack of [[Pep pop]]s at the rebuilt Cobblestone shop, about 20 split across the party.
Buy [[Elfin elixir]]s at the Octagonia Casino; [[Magic Burst]] deals about three times [[Veronica]]'s MP, and each of the two parts has 20,000 HP.
Bring the [[Luminary]], [[Erik]], [[Veronica]] and [[Rab]].
Equip [[Catholicon ring]]s against the sleep and confusion attacks.
Pep Up all four in a normal battle by defending, swapping each one out once Pepped to keep the state.
Fly [[Cetacea]] into the rift above the Tower of Lost Time.
Open the fight with [[Yggdragon's Blessing]] which makes your characters invulnerable to damage.
When the Blessing icon starts flashing, throw a [[Pep pop]] so you can cast it again; it only lasts 2-3 turns.
Hit the [[Timewyrm's tail]] first with [[Magic Burst]], refilling [[Veronica]] with [[Elfin elixir]]s; expect Disruptive Wave at every phase switch.
When the main body casts its double-MP mist, keep using [[Magic Burst]] but expect half damage per cast.
In the final phase, if either part gets Pepped, strip it with [[Rab]]'s [[Rake 'n' Break]] or [[Clear Your Mind]] to stop [[Malicious Magic Burst]] and Blackest Mark.
If fighting normally, reapply [[Kabuff]], [[Magic Barrier]] and [[Insulatle]] each phase.
If fighting normally, bring the [[Luminary]] and [[Serena]] for [[Omniheal]].
If fighting normally, attack with [[Sword Dance]].
Use the [[Sands of Lost Time]] to refight it if you want the Accolades for winning in under 70 or under 50 turns.

get: [[Hare-raising suit]] - Timewyrm reward, auto-revives Jade, final costume
[[Sands of Lost Time]] - Timewyrm reward, lets you refight it
